newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE FEB 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE FEB 24.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Government minimises impact of protest movement against bill tightening controls on immigration.
-- Retail group Pinault-Printemps-Redoute to reshuffle executives, Francois-Henri Pinault to be appointed head of bookstores chain FNAC.

-- Government seeks to expropriate Eramet's subsidiary Societe Le Nickel of its mining rights for the Koniambo, New-Caledonia nickel fields, probably without compensation. Shares in Eramet plunged 5.2 percent at the bourse opening Monday.
-- Eurotunnel says bank syndicate approved extension of debt standstill date to December 14, 1997.
